subject.title: feat: unify Claude Code / Codex session catalogs into native session UX

question: Should external session catalogs become a public generic Plugin SDK surface and remain operator-visible whenever the owning plugin is active, independent of agent-facing supervision enablement?
rationale: This creates a permanent external plugin API and changes the product meaning of an existing operator setting; automated review cannot choose that long-term contract.

options.title: Approve generic always-visible catalogs
options.body: Keep the public SDK and Gateway seam, with operator catalogs active whenever the plugin is active and agent-facing supervision tools remaining opt-in.

options.title: Keep catalog visibility opt-in
options.body: Retain the generic seam but preserve supervision-enabled catalog visibility for compatibility with existing operator expectations.

options.title: Defer the public SDK contract
options.body: Narrow this PR to owner-specific native UX and revisit the external API after more implementations and live evidence exist.

recommendation.title: Approve generic always-visible catalogs
recommendation.body: Keep the public SDK and Gateway seam, with operator catalogs active whenever the plugin is active and agent-facing supervision tools remaining opt-in.
